faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Corporate Outreach Officer post at RGIPT?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Corporate Outreach Officer position at Rajiv Gandhi Institute of Petroleum Technology is 30th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for this role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's Degree in Business Administration (MBA/PGDM) or a Master's in Corporate Communications or Public Relations (PR).

faq.question: Q3. Is there any experience required for the Corporate Outreach Officer position?
faq.answer: Yes, a minimum of 5 years of experience in corporate relations, placement, business development, or talent acquisition is required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to this post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Corporate Outreach Officer post is 40 years as of 30th September 2026.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the RGIPT Corporate Outreach Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply online through the RGIPT Recruitment Portal, the link for which is provided in the Important Links section.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Corporate Outreach Officer role?
faq.answer: The remuneration will be contractual, referencing Level 7 of the 7th CPC, along with other applicable allowances as per Institute rules.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies for the Corporate Outreach Officer post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Corporate Outreach Officer position advertised by RGIPT.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Corporate Outreach Officer position is offered on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the RGIPT website or accessed via the link provided in the Important Links section of this article.
